svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.37k stars in total, about 1.84k a year earlier. jactionlint 333, mr boxington 752, aube 2071, fnox 2379, hk 1313, pitchfork 714, usage 1076, +6 more 735.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
